script_text: Taurus, your money and love life collide this week in a way you cannot ignore. Early week, Venus in your eighth house squares Mars in your second house, pressuring finances while an undercurrent of desire builds. Monday and Tuesday feel heavy for career talks, but Wednesday turns electric as Mercury sextiles your ruling planet Venus, sharpening negotiations and flirtation. Midweek, Jupiter trines your Sun in your seventh house, shifting everything through a powerful partnership opportunity. Late week, the Moon in your tenth house trines Saturn, stabilizing your career and giving you authority in love. Saturday and Sunday favor sensual bonding and a surprise financial gain. Your best day is Wednesday because Venus activates your fifth house of romance. Your worst day is Monday because Mars squares your second house of income. Ground earth energy by investing in one beautiful, lasting thing. Follow for daily updates.
